input.name: plaintext
input.label: File content

input.name: public_key
input.label: Public key
input.hint: Public key of the recipient to encrypt the message with or it will use public key from the connection. Learn how to generate a pair of Public key & Private key here.

input.name: sign
input.label: Sign
input.hint: Input document will be encrypted and signed with PGP. Private key and passphrase from the connection setting will be used to sign the document.

input.name: original_filename
input.label: File name
input.hint: Original name of the input file. If empty, file name will be auto generated.

input.name: ascii_armor
input.label: ASCII armor
input.hint: The encrypted content will consist of printable ASCII characters. The content can be sent in a standard messaging format such as email.

input.name: armor_comment
input.label: Armor comment header
input.hint: The comment to include in the armor header of the encrypted content.
